text: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāvento #1 yu. kāci . evamuparipi . ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkaronto nibbānaninno hoti nibbānapoṇo nibbānapabbhāro . idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhiṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ .pe. sammāsamādhiṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ
